faqs.q: When can bats be removed from a Sandston attic?
faqs.a: Bats in Virginia are handled by exclusion only — one-way exits fitted and every other opening sealed so the colony leaves on its own. Under our permit conditions the maternity season runs May 1 through August 15, and bats may not be excluded or removed then unless no young are present or there is a threat to human health or safety, so we inspect any time but schedule most Sandston exclusions outside that window.
